toolCall.argumentsJson: {"CommandLine":"$env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'; Set-Content -Path \"$env:TEMP\\nexlev_watch.json\" -Value '{\"videoUrl\": \"https://youtu.be/fXuWQg7uJKg\", \"question\": \"You are analyzing this video EDITING AND ANIMATION PRODUCTION STYLE for a creator who wants to replicate this format as a faceless 2D animated history channel. Produce a detailed Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) covering EVERY editing technique visible in this video. Be extremely specific and technical: 1. ANIMATION STYLE: What type of 2D animation is used? Custom illustrated characters or template-based? How are they animated (frame-by-frame, puppet rigging, simple transforms)? Detail level of characters? 2. TEXT ANIMATIONS: Every on-screen text instance - font style, motion type (pop-in, slide, typewriter, kinetic typography?), placement (center, lower-third, full-screen?), duration, color/outline treatment. Note each different text style. 3. TRANSITIONS: Document every transition type. Hard cuts, animated wipes, map pans, camera zooms? What percentage are hard cuts vs animated? 4. CAMERA WORK IN 2D: How do they simulate camera movement in flat art? Zooms, pans, tracking shots, parallax layers? Speed and easing? 5. COLOR AND VISUAL TREATMENT: Color palette, contrast level, filters/LUTs, background treatment, lighting simulation in 2D. 6. MAPS AND DIAGRAMS: Map styling, territory change animations, timeline presentation, geopolitical overlays. 7. PACING AND CUT RHYTHM: Average shot duration, cuts per minute, where holds happen, where rapid sequences happen. Timestamp examples. 8. SOUND DESIGN: SFX usage frequency and types (whooshes, impacts, comedic hits, ambient), music bed changes, audio transitions, narrator pacing sync. 9. RECURRING VISUAL PATTERNS: Repeated motifs, intro/outro style, thumbnail connections, recurring graphic elements. 10. PRODUCIBILITY SOP: Step-by-step workflow a SOLO creator would follow to produce one video in this style. Software recommendations, asset creation pipeline, editing sequence, realistic time estimates. Format as a structured SOP. Be specific and technical, not vague.\"}' -Encoding UTF8; python \"C:\\Users\\renu5\\.gemini\\config\\skills\\nexlev-mcp-caller\\scripts\\nexlev_call.py\" watch_youtube_video_and_ask \"$env:TEMP\\nexlev_watch.json\"","Cwd":"C:\\Users\\renu5\\.gemini\\config\\skills\\nexlev-mcp-caller","WaitMsBeforeAsync":500,"toolAction":"Calling NexLev video analysis","toolSummary":"NexLev video watch"}
